scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets/fonts/montserrat && cp -r src/html/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r src/assets dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r src/css dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r src/js dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp node_modules/aos/dist/aos.css dist/css/aos.css && cp node_modules/aos/dist/aos.js dist/js/aos.js && cp node_modules/@fontsource/montserrat/files/montserrat-{cyrillic,cyrillic-ext,latin,latin-ext}-{400,500,600,700,800}-normal.woff2 dist/assets/fonts/montserrat/
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd dist && python3 -m http.server 8000
